_help: Edit this file to change what the dashboard tracks. 'ice' components map to ICE Status Center platform IDs. 'checks' are simple 'does the website answer' tests run from GitHub. Add your own portal URLs (e.g. your KRM22 login page) to a platform's checks list.

components.name: WebICE (energy futures & OTC)
components.note: WebICE is the trading screen for these ICE markets; ICE doesn't list WebICE on its own.

components.name: ICE Connect
components.note: ICE doesn't list ICE Connect by name; tracked through its Data & Analytics desktop and ICE Launcher entries.

platforms.name: Bloomberg Terminal
platforms.support: Bloomberg Help: press HELP twice on the Terminal, or call +1 212 318 2000
platforms.about: Bloomberg doesn't publish a public status page. This tab shows website checks plus any status you set by hand.

platforms.name: Cloud9 Trader (C9)
platforms.about: Cloud9 doesn't publish a public status page. This tab shows website checks plus any status you set by hand.

platforms.name: KRM22
platforms.about: KRM22 doesn't publish a public status page. Add your KRM22 portal URL to platforms.config.json for a direct check.
